title: 6 Strange Things Found in Antarctica
description:
A pyramid in Antarctica? A glacier that bleeds? Signals coming up out of the ice? Here are six strange things found in Antarctica, what scientists actually found, and an honest verdict for each: solved, best guess, or still unknown.

0:00 A pyramid in Antarctica?
0:21 #1 The pyramid
1:29 #2 Blood Falls
2:46 #3 The hole in the sea ice
4:23 #4 The "ice-free" map
5:24 #5 Life in Lake Vostok
6:29 #6 Signals from inside the Earth
7:38 Scoreboard

3D scenes are illustrations based on the sources. Map positions are approximate.
